mask_policy.labels: Fixed clip regions, not semantic foliage/bottle/facade labels
mask_policy.core: Two-pixel image border excluded; original finite positive depth
mask_policy.available_pair: core AND four previous bilinear taps inside previous crop; t0 false
mask_policy.depth_edge: core AND any 4-connected original depth jump >2% of current magnitude
mask_policy.normal_edge: core AND any 4-connected original normal dot <cos(15 degrees)
mask_policy.high_motion: original full-render motion magnitude >12 pixels, square erosion radius2
mask_policy.stable_guide_pair: available_pair; all four previous original normal dots >.99; all depths within2% of current depth+MV.B; identical categories
mask_policy.sampling: continuous NumPy bilinear; explicitly not a D3D sampler-parity claim
mask_policy.first_previous_frame: absent; no sequence looping or invented history

clips.stage: Captured native inputs + recorded raw/selected RR; CPU diagnostics only
clips.timing: Frame ordinals only. recording_qpc/frame durations absent; no Hz or per-second claims.

input_diffuse.unit: captured linear lobe units (not display RGB); input alpha is unmodified hit distance
input_diffuse.lag_one_correlation_scope: Eulerian local crop indices, not advected material points; moving crop changes their world correspondence. Not an estimator of Monte Carlo noise correlation.
input_diffuse.interpretation: Variation mixes lighting, stochastic samples, reprojection, motion, and geometry; no causal noise/flicker attribution or converged truth. Clamped depth is observed; absent raw validity prevents physical correspondence certification.
